interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, slowing turning speeds and reducing pedestrian exposure.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Minimize the number and width of driveway curb cuts to reduce the frequency of vehicle-pedestrian conflict points.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and lighting.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Mid-block crossing with refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a raised refuge island to allow for staged crossing of the four-lane road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk buffer and street trees
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to separate the walkway from moving vehicles and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Driveway narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance to slow turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian conflict zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the right-of-way or into a newly created buffer zone to clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island, to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install permanent bollards along the edge of the walkway to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Raised Curb Construction
interventions.description: Install a standard raised curb to provide physical and psychological separation between the roadway and the walkway.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated space for pedestrians to cross.
